label: Ище
description: A 10-sentence card for the augmentative suffix -ище/-ища.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: домище from дом. The augmentative -ище turns дом 'house' into домище 'huge house', stressing great, even excessive size.
Strategic focus: ручища from рука. The augmentative -ища makes рука 'hand, arm' into ручища 'huge hand', a large and slightly coarse form.
Strategic focus: голосище from голос. The augmentative -ище turns голос 'voice' into голосище 'mighty voice', emphasising great power and volume.
Strategic focus: котище from кот. The augmentative -ище makes кот 'cat' into котище 'huge cat', adding largeness with a rough, comic edge.
Strategic focus: силища from сила. The augmentative -ища turns сила 'strength' into силища 'enormous strength', exaggerating power.
Strategic focus: ножища from нога. The augmentative -ища makes нога 'leg' into ножища 'huge leg', large and somewhat coarse in tone.
Strategic focus: contrast домик and домище. The diminutive домик means a 'little house', while домище with -ище means a 'huge house'; the pair shows the augmentative reversing the size nuance.

missions.phrase: Этот котище весит целых десять килограммов.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: котище from кот. Again -ище gives котище 'huge cat' a sense of bulk and rough humour about the animal's size.
Strategic focus: contrast дом and домище. The plain дом names a normal house, while домище with -ище signals an enormous one; the pair shows the augmentative adding largeness.
Strategic focus: голосище from голос. The augmentative -ище makes голосище 'huge voice' fill the hall, underlining overwhelming size and force.
